questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 1.1

Which structure in the nucleus contains the genetic code for a specific protein?
questions.explanation: A gene is a segment of DNA that codes for a specific polypeptide/protein.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 1.2

Name the nitrogenous base that pairs with adenine in DNA.
questions.explanation: In DNA, adenine pairs with thymine (A–T).

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 2.1

DNA replication is described as semi-conservative because …

options.text: each new double helix has one old and one new strand
all DNA is destroyed and rebuilt

questions.explanation: Semi-conservative replication retains one parental strand in each daughter molecule.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 3.1

Name the scientist most associated with the theory of natural selection.
questions.explanation: Charles Darwin (with Wallace) proposed natural selection as a mechanism of evolution.

questions.prompt:
Official NSC · Nov 2022 · Life Sciences Paper 1 · Question 4.1

Which action best supports biodiversity conservation?
questions.explanation: Habitat protection maintains species and ecosystem diversity.
